name: Claire
source:
A dutiful student who prefers the company of home or her close friends.
Her self-consciousness makes it hard for her to be outgoing, and she has insecurities surrounding dating and sex.
Disappointed that university didn't turn out as exciting as she hoped for, she predicts spring break will be no different...
